round_assessment.reason: The complete actual remainder has exact ordered HKLDW and whole-functional level1/2 Heegner formulations with paid scalar transforms and tails. The stated point fourth moment and individual Hecke norm give raw A^2 T N^2; even a hypothetical free fixed-sieve-size twisted norm leaves A^2 T N^(3/2). The elementary A^2 N^2 cap is still stronger and gives no new complete exponent. The actual signed spectral inequality at A^2 N^(3/2) remains unproved.
